lines.text: Choose which server you play on and how you sign in to it.
Learn indirect control: scout with a flag, supply your colony, and direct an attack.
Open Flags and place an Exploration Flag over the stone patch east of your colony. Assign one explorer. Watch it travel to the flag.

Construction and everyday supply have separate worker targets. Select the finished Inn and increase its operating target. A supplier gathers wheat and carries it here. Hungry globules eat at Inns; a building with no suppliers will eventually run out. Keep

Open Flags, choose War Flag, place it over the enemy Swarm east of the stone and confirm. Select the flag and request up to 4 warriors. A small radius concentrates them. If none remain, produce warriors at your Swarm. Warriors may stop to eat; keep
Build a Hospital and help a wounded worker recover. The colony starts fed, with one injured worker.
Open Flags, choose Guard and paint at least 4 tiles inside the area. Guard zones attract idle warriors. Forbidden zones block travel; clearing zones request resource removal.

What the colony's workers were doing, moment by moment: working for a building, working at a flag, training, eating, healing, waiting hungry or hurt with no inn or hospital free, or idle with nothing to do. A healthy colony keeps most of its workers
working, few idle and none waiting.
The average attack level of the colony's warriors, counting attack speed and attack strength equally, on the 1 to 4 scale the game shows. Barracks raise it; new untrained warriors pull it down.
